input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: We reviewed every payment, termination and liability provision (§ 3 compensation and taxes, § 6(a)-(b) termination, § 7(c) post-termination payment, § 7 liability caps) and searched for liquidated damages, penalties, stipulated or minimum termination amounts, kill fees and late-payment charges. There is no amount payable by Clear Capital as liquidated damages or a penalty anywhere in the Agreement. Termination is available to either party for any or no reason on fifteen days' notice with no exit fee, and on termination RadialSpark is entitled only to fees and expenses actually "incurred or earned" through the effective date, which is payment for value delivered rather than a liquidated amount. Section 3 imposes no interest or penalty on late payment. This satisfies the preferred position that Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties, so no redline is proposed.
